mentions.h: APRIL 6th 1976 - DUKE OF YORK'S BARRACKS, CHELSEA - DUKES 10 LAP HANDICAP.

mentions.note: acted as pilot; first home in the 1952 race in 2:08:35

distance runner and Club Champion; bests include marathon 2hr 46min 06sec (Poly Marathon 1952) and London - Brighton 6hr 38min 20sec (1952); in his latter 50s in 1977; born in Kensington June 2nd 1921; schoolboy at Beaufort House; Church Lads Brigade; joined Belgrave November 2nd 1938; won five mile cross country handicap October 1947; first Polytechnic Marathon 1948 in 3 hours 17 minutes 1 second; ran fourteen consecutive Poly marathons, last in 1961; 29th and first Belgrave home in the 1952 Polytechnic Marathon (Olympic trial), 2 hours 46 minutes 6 seconds, earning a Club Championship and Honours Badge; 16th in the first Road Runners Club London to Brighton run, August 27th 1952; R.R.C. 2nd class award 1954; made a Vice-President in 1972
